fields.name: guidance_scale
fields.title: Guidance Scale
fields.description: Guidance Scale is a measure of how close you want the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description: The seed to use for the generation. If not provided, a random seed will be used.

fields.name: num_inference_steps
fields.title: Number of Inference Steps
fields.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

fields.name: image_size
fields.title: Image Size
fields.description: The size of the image to generate. The width and height must be between 512 and 2048 pixels.

fields.name: acceleration
fields.title: Acceleration
fields.description: The acceleration level to use for the image generation.

fields.name: enable_prompt_expansion
fields.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
fields.description: If set to true, the prompt will be expanded for better results.

fields.name: output_format
fields.title: Output Format
fields.description: The format of the generated image.
